current.summary: L-shaped kitchen, largely fitted. Base units in a deep teal-green with raised-panel doors and a glossy dark walnut-effect worktop. Sink run: black inset sink with black pull-out tap, slim dishwasher, grey-green metro-tile splashback finished with a brass trim, dark charcoal glazed wall cabinets with an open shelf below. Hob run: 4-burner gas hob, built-in stainless oven, black chimney hood, splashback in square pale-green tiles with brass trim. A wooden window to the front sits over the corner of the worktop. The arched opening beside the hob leads to the lounge (currently covered with a black sheet). Oak-tone glazed double doors lead to the back terrace. Floor: large light-grey stone-effect tiles with matching tile skirting. Recessed ceiling downlights. The far end opens to the fridge & utility room and the bathroom door.
keep: Teal-green units, walnut-effect worktop, black sink and tap
Both tiled splashbacks with their brass trims
issues: JOB 1 — Handles: 3 drawers, 5 cupboard doors, dishwasher, 2 for the IKEA wall cupboard = 11
JOB 2 — Extractor hood: wire in and finish (the loose cable coil beside it is its supply; duct and chimney cover to complete)
JOB 3 — Fit the new IKEA wall cupboard when it arrives
JOB 4 — Electrics: make safe the open junction box by the terrace doors and the open hole high on the wall
JOB 5 — Walls and ceiling: make good patches, holes and cracks at the downlights, then paint
JOB 6 — Front window: finish the frame and reveal
JOB 7 — Close off the raw end panel of the hob run
To decide: charcoal wall cabinets vs teal units — keep as is or unify; terrace-door inside sill/threshold finish

target.concept: The kitchen itself is done; seven jobs finish the room around it: handles, the hood wired in, the IKEA cupboard up, electrics safe, walls and ceiling smooth and painted warm white, the window finished and the unit end closed. No change to units, worktop, tiles or appliances.

palette.role: tile trims, handles on terrace doors — repeat for any new hardware

furniture.name: Handles — recommendation: aged/brushed brass
furniture.detail: Brass picks up the tile trims and the terrace-door handles. 5 knobs (about 30 mm) for cupboard doors, 3 cup pulls for drawers, 1 bar handle about 160 mm for the dishwasher (a knob is too weak for a sprung door), 2 knobs for the IKEA wall cupboard. Before buying: check whether the doors are already drilled and measure the hole spacing.

scope: Wire in and finish the extractor hood

surfaces.prep: Electrician: permanent connection via a fused spur or socket hidden inside the chimney — no trailing cable. Confirm whether it ducts outside (hole through the wall + external grille) or recirculates (carbon filters fitted).
surfaces.finish: Fit chimney cover to the ceiling; make good the wall around it
surfaces.notes: Gas hob below: check the hood height against the hob maker's minimum (usually 65–75 cm)

surfaces.prep: Fill and sand patches, skim where needed, mist coat on new plaster
Fill holes and cracks, tape cracks at downlights, skim

notes: Order: electrician (hood, junction box) → plaster → paint → IKEA cupboard → handles
